objectives.description: Describe one's relevant capabilities without duplicating general personality senses.

objectives.description: Account earlier digital meanings used within a connected task explanation.

objectives.description: Explain what was measured, the unit and an approximate result.
frameworkSections: 16.5; general notions 2.6 (specific notions unless explicitly marked otherwise)

Pressure is independently selected in159 with unit rows160–162; temperature instrument163 and reference/value164–167 complete the readout scenario. The numeric/unit-form prerequisite below explicitly closes prefixes and temperature labels. objectives.description: Read a bounded number-plus-unit measurement and recognize its symbol without expanding every derived form into a word.

objectives.description: Describe a simple material state or temperature change with shared meanings.
